faq.q: Is there a median price for Chilliwack townhomes under $1.2M?
faq.a: No figure is given here: Chilliwack is CADREB territory, SnapStats has no Chilliwack coverage, and CADREB publishes board-wide statistics only, so no band count, share or median exists in program sources (SnapStats, September 2026) (as of November 1, 2026))

faq.q: Which schools serve the Sardis and Promontory townhome areas, by name and address?
faq.a: Promontory Heights Community Elementary at 46200 Stoneview Dr, Vedder Elementary at 45850 Promontory Rd, Vedder Middle School at 45560 South Sumas Rd and Sardis Secondary at 45460 Stevenson Rd, Chilliwack, all confirmed in the BC Ministry K-12 file; catchments are address-based and must be run per address

faq.q: What zoning bylaw governs Chilliwack townhomes, and what is its SSMUH amendment?
faq.a: Chilliwack Zoning Bylaw 5000 governs, and its small-scale multi-unit housing amendment is Bylaw 5395, adopted June 18, 2024

faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in Chilliwack?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.

faq.q: Are townhomes in Chilliwack freehold or strata?
faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.
